source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 31 (PDF 217-231), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 31 (Materials and Energy) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Why were new materials and machines needed by humans?
(Insaanon ko naye materials aur machines ki zaroorat kyun pari?)
blocks.explanation: Aabadi mein bohat izafa aur mehdood qudrati wasail ki wajah se insaani zaroorat poori karne ke liye naye materials aur machines chahiye thin. Is se metal alloys se nanomaterials tak aur bare cells se chhoti efficient batteries tak bani.

book_ref.quote: new materials and machines were needed to fulfill the human needs

blocks.prompt:
2 Define a material and give two examples.
(Material ki definition likhein aur do misaalen dein.)
blocks.explanation: Material koi bhi substance ya substances ka mixture hai jo rozmarra ya sanati ahmiyat ki koi physical cheez banata hai. Misaalen: plastics, metals, ceramics, building material.

book_ref.quote: A material is any substance or mixture of substances that makes up a physical object

blocks.prompt:
3 On what basis is a material selected for a certain application?
(Kisi khaas kaam ke liye material kis bunyaad par chuna jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Material us ki physical, chemical, mechanical, electrical aur thermal khususiyaat ki bunyaad par chuna jata hai. Materials ko un ki composition, chemical bonds ki nature aur microstructure se samjha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The selection of a material for a certain application is made depending on its physical

blocks.prompt:
4 Give reasons: (i) aluminium is used in aircraft bodies, (ii) steel is used in bridges.
(Wajah batayein: (i) aluminium aircraft ki body mein kyun, (ii) steel pulon mein kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Aluminium halka (light-weight) hai is liye aircraft ki body mein lagta hai. (ii) Steel mazboot hai is liye pulon aur buildings mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: These characteristics allow the use of metals in indoor construction and industries.

blocks.prompt:
5 What is an ore? What is gangue?
(Ore kya hai? Gangue kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ore woh combined shakal hai jis mein zyada reactive metal zameen ki tah mein milti hai, jaise haematite (Fe₂O₃) iron ki ore hai. Ores khalis compounds nahi balke matloob metal compound, impurities aur mitti wale materials ka mixture hain; is mitti wale hisse ko gangue kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Ores are not pure compounds, rather mixtures of the desired metal compound impurities

blocks.prompt:
6 Define metallurgy. What decides the extraction procedure of a metal?
(Metallurgy ki definition likhein. Metal nikalne ka tareeqa kya tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Metallurgy metals ko un ki ores se nikalne aur behtar istemal ke liye khalis karne ki science hai. Metal ki reactivity aur nature nikalne ka tareeqa tay karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Metallurgy is the science of extracting metals out of their ores

blocks.prompt:
7 What are mining and ore concentration?
(Mining aur ore concentration kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mining zameen mein gehrai par dabi metal ores hasil karne ka process hai, jaise iron ores. Ore concentration mein ore ko jitna ho sake impurities se paak kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Mining is the process of acquiring the metal ores that are buried deep in the earth.

blocks.prompt:
8 Differentiate between roasting and calcination.
(Roasting aur calcination mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono concentrated ore ko metal oxide mein badalte hain; farq neeche hai.

book_ref.quote: The first method is roasting which involves heating a sulphide ore

rows: Sulphide ore garam ki jati hai
Carbonate ore garam ki jati hai
Zyada hawa mein
Kam ya baghair hawa ke
2ZnS(s) + 3O₂(g) → 2ZnO(s) + 2SO₂(g)
ZnCO₃(s) → ZnO(s) + CO₂(g)
Oxide ke saath SO₂ banti hai
Oxide ke saath CO₂ banti hai

blocks.prompt:
9 Using 2ZnS + 3O₂ → 2ZnO + 2SO₂, calculate the moles of O₂ needed and SO₂ formed when 5 mol of ZnS are roasted.
(2ZnS + 3O₂ → 2ZnO + 2SO₂ ke mutabiq 5 mol ZnS roast karne par O₂ ke kitne moles lagenge aur SO₂ ke kitne banenge?)
blocks.explanation: 2 mol ZnS ko 3 mol O₂ chahiye aur 2 mol SO₂ banti hai. O₂ = 5 × 3/2 = 7.5 mol; SO₂ = 5 × 2/2 = 5 mol.

book_ref.quote: This can be done in two ways, mostly.

blocks.prompt:
10 Which step of metal extraction is the most important? How are oxides of metals below carbon reduced?
(Metal nikalne ka sab se ahem step kaun sa hai? Carbon se neeche wali metals ke oxides kaise reduce hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Metal oxides ki reduction sab se ahem step hai. Reactivity series mein carbon se neeche wali metals ke liye carbon reducing agent hai: pehle CO banti hai jo oxygen nikalti hai, jaise C + ½O₂ → CO; Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂.

book_ref.quote: The reduction of metal oxides is the most important step of metal extraction.

blocks.prompt:
11 Why are sodium, potassium and aluminium extracted by an electrolytic method?
(Sodium, potassium aur aluminium electrolytic tareeqe se kyun nikale jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh metals carbon se zyada reactive hain, is liye carbon in ke oxides reduce nahi kar sakta. In ke compounds pighla kar current guzara jata hai; positive metal ions cathode par ja kar electrons lete hain aur metal bante hain.

book_ref.quote: which requires significant energy to melt the metal compounds and pass an electric current through them

blocks.prompt:
12 What is refining of a metal? Name its methods.
(Metal ki refining kya hai? Is ke tareeqe batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Refining reduction ke baad mili metal ko aakhri dafa khalis karna hai, jo khaas kaamon ke liye zaroori hai (jaise wiring ke liye 99.99% khalis copper). Refining thermal, chemical ya electrochemical tareeqon se hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A metal can be refined by thermal, chemical or electrochemical methods.

blocks.prompt:
13 What is alloying? Why is it done?
(Alloying kya hai? Yeh kyun ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alloying do ya zyada metals ko mila kar homogeneous solution banana, ya metal ko non-metal se milana hai. Is se metal ka microstructure badal kar strength, corrosion resistance aur electrical ya magnetic properties behtar hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Alloying involves the mixing of any two or more metals to give a homogeneous solution

blocks.prompt:
14 Give the composition and one use each of duralumin and bronze.
(Duralumin aur bronze ki composition aur aik aik istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Duralumin: aluminium (93-95%) + copper (3.5-4.5%) + magnesium (0.4-0.7%) + manganese (0.4-0.7%); halka, mazboot – aircraft body. Bronze: copper (88%) + tin (12%); sakht, ghisne se mehfooz – medals, statues.

book_ref.quote: Common alloys and their uses are provided in Table 31.1.

blocks.prompt:
15 A 400 g brass fitting contains 75% copper and the rest zinc. Find the masses of copper and zinc. Is it within the brass range of Table 31.1?
(400 g brass fitting mein 75% copper aur baqi zinc hai. Copper aur zinc ka mass maloom karein. Kya yeh Table 31.1 ki brass range mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cu = 0.75 × 400 = 300 g; Zn = 400 − 300 = 100 g (25%). Haan: brass mein copper 60-90% aur zinc 10-40% hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
16 What are ceramics? Give their chemical composition.
(Ceramics kya hain? In ki chemical composition batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Ceramics sakht magar brittle (bhurbhure) materials hain jin ka melting point zyada aur insulation behtareen hai. Kemiyai taur par in mein alkali, alkaline earth metals aur aluminium ke silicates aur oxides hote hain, jaise K₂O, Na₂O, CaO, Al₂SiO₅.

book_ref.quote: Chemically, they contain a blend of silicates and oxides of alkali and alkaline earth metals

blocks.prompt:
17 Why are ceramics strong, durable and resistant to corrosion and heat? Give two uses.
(Ceramics mazboot, paedaar aur corrosion aur heat se mehfooz kyun hain? Do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Ceramics ke mazboot bonds aur pakki structures inhen strength, paedaari aur corrosion aur heat se hifazat dete hain. Istemal: pottery, furnaces, tiles aur sanitary ware (porcelain), windows aur optical fibres (glass), spark plugs (alumina).

book_ref.quote: The strong bonds and fixed structures give ceramics unique and highly desirable properties

blocks.prompt:
18 Write one application example each for hardness and for chemical inertness of ceramics.
(Ceramics ki hardness aur chemical inertness ki aik aik application likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hardness aur wear resistance: abrasives jaise sandpaper mein silicon carbide, aur cutting tools. Chemical inertness (corrosion aur chemical hamle se mehfooz): chemical processing equipment par ceramic coatings.

book_ref.quote: Table 31.2 Properties of ceramics and their applications

blocks.prompt:
19 What are polymers? Which type is more common?
(Polymers kya hain? Kaun si qisam zyada aam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polymers bare inorganic ya organic molecules hain jin ki khaas properties hain aur jo chhote molecules se banaye jate hain. Organic polymers zyada aam hain magar kuch applications mein inorganic polymers zyada ahem hain.

book_ref.quote: Polymers are large inorganic or organic molecules having unique properties.

blocks.prompt:
20 What is a composite? Give two examples with their uses.
(Composite kya hai? Do misaalen istemal ke saath dein.)
blocks.explanation: Composite do ya zyada materials ka mel hai jis se behtar properties wali cheez banti hai. Misaalen: fibreglass – boat hulls aur car bodies (aur deewaron/chhat ki insulation); carbon fibre – aircraft aur sports gear.

book_ref.quote: A composite is a combination of two or more materials to form a product which has better properties.

blocks.prompt:
21 Why are composites suitable for demanding applications?
(Composites mushkil applications ke liye kyun munasib hain?)
blocks.explanation: Composites ka strength-to-weight ratio achha aur corrosion resistance mazboot hota hai. Is liye inhen wahan istemal karte hain jahan material halka, mazboot aur paedaar chahiye, jaise car bodies aur aircraft.

book_ref.quote: Composites possess good strength to weight ratio and strong resistance to corrosion

blocks.prompt:
22 Name the matrix and the possible reinforcement agents in fibreglass.
(Fibreglass mein matrix aur mumkina reinforcement agents ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Fibreglass mein matrix polymer hai. Reinforcement agent fabric, glass ya carbon wale materials ke fibres ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: and the reinforcement agent may be the fibres of a fabric, glass, or carbon-based materials

blocks.prompt:
23 Differentiate between conductors and semiconductors.
(Conductors aur semiconductors mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Chapter mein diye gaye farq table mein hain.

book_ref.quote: Semiconductors are substances conducting electricity only in special conditions

rows: Heat aur bijli ke achhe conductors
Sirf khaas halaat mein bijli guzarte hain
Current is tarah control nahi hota
Current ko zaroorat ke mutabiq control kiya ja sakta hai
Misaal: electric wires mein copper
Misaal: microchips aur solar panels mein silicon

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is silicon the most common semiconductor? Give two of its uses.
(Silicon sab se aam semiconductor kyun hai? Is ke do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Silicon bohat effective aur waafir hai. Yeh microchips aur solar panels mein istemal hota hai; mobile SIM card silicon chip hai, aur silicon device mein data guzar, store aur process kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: since it is highly effective and abundant

blocks.prompt:
25 Define toxicity. How is the toxicity of a material measured?
(Toxicity ki definition likhein. Material ki toxicity kaise naapi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Toxicity woh had hai jis tak substance jaandaar ya mahol ko nuqsan de sakta hai. Ise us hazard ki had aur qisam se naapa jata hai jo material tayyari, istemal aur disposal mein paida kare.

book_ref.quote: The toxicity is measured by the extent and type of hazard that a material may cause.

blocks.prompt:
26 What are carcinogens and mutagens? Give an example.
(Carcinogens aur mutagens kya hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Carcinogens cancer paida karne wale substances hain; mutagens DNA aur genes badalne wale substances hain. Misaal: chromium jaisi metals carcinogen aur mutagen hain aur saans ke masail bhi deti hain.

book_ref.quote: mutagens (change DNA and genes)

blocks.prompt:
27 Name the three types of hazards posed by materials with one example of each.
(Materials se paida hone wale teen qisam ke hazards aik aik misaal ke saath batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Health hazard: chromium (cancer, DNA tabdeeli) ya plastic additives (hormonal masail). Physical hazard: flammable ya explosive material jo insaan, jangal ya building ko nuqsan de. Environmental hazard: lead, mercury, cadmium ka mitti aur zameeni paani mein rissna jo aabi zindagi ko nuqsan de.

book_ref.quote: Hazards posed by a material are of many types.

blocks.prompt:
28 Why are heavy metals such as Pb, Hg and Cd considered major toxic materials?
(Pb, Hg aur Cd jaisi heavy metals ko bare zehreele materials kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lead, mercury aur cadmium electronics, batteries aur fluorescent lights mein aam hain. Yeh zameeni paani mein pohanch kar wahan se jaandaaron mein chali jati hain aur paudon, janwaron aur aabi zindagi ko nuqsan deti hain.

book_ref.quote: They can get into the ground water from where they can transfer to the living organisms.

blocks.prompt:
29 How are plastics a toxic concern for humans and the environment?
(Plastics insaan aur mahol ke liye zehreeli pareshani kaise hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se plastics mein phthalates ya bisphenol A (BPA) jaise zehreele additives hote hain jo hormones mein khalal daalte hain. Microplastics ab samandar, mitti aur khane mein bhi milte hain aur insaan aur ecosystem par lamba asar daalte hain.

book_ref.quote: toxic additives such as phthalates or bisphenol A (BPA)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke microplastics insaanon mein carcinogenic paye gaye; book correction ke mutabiq yeh sabit nahi, sirf shak hai. Is liye jawab mein sirf 'lamba asar' likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
30 State two advantages of recycling.
(Recycling ke do faide batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Yeh landfills mein kachra kam karti hai aur metals, tel aur lakri jaise mehdood wasail bachati hai. (ii) Yeh energy bachati hai, jaise aluminium ki recycling raw ore ke muqable mein 95 percent kam energy leti hai.

book_ref.quote: Recycling minimizes the solid wastes in the landfills

blocks.prompt:
31 If 150 MJ is needed to produce 1 kg of aluminium from its raw ore (assumed value), how much energy is needed and how much saved when 8 kg of aluminium is recycled?
(Agar raw ore se 1 kg aluminium banane mein 150 MJ lagte hain (farz karein), to 8 kg aluminium recycle karne mein kitni energy lagegi aur kitni bachegi?)
blocks.explanation: Primary energy = 8 × 150 = 1200 MJ. Recycling 5% leti hai: 0.05 × 1200 = 60 MJ. Bachat = 1200 − 60 = 1140 MJ.

book_ref.quote: the recycling of aluminium consumes 95 percent less energy

blocks.prompt:
32 What is the contamination challenge in recycling?
(Recycling mein contamination (aaludgi) ka challenge kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reprocessing aksar product ko aaluda kar deti hai: recycled metals aur plastics dyes, chemicals ya biological materials se aaluda ho kar quality aur hifazat kho dete hain. Contaminated plastic food-grade istemal ke liye recycle nahi ho sakta.

book_ref.quote: posing the contamination challenges

blocks.prompt:
33 How is paper recycled?
(Paper kaise recycle hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paper pulping aur de-inking se recycle hota hai: fibres ki chemical aur mechanical alehdgi. Pulp ko NaOH ya Na₂CO₃ jaise chemicals se treat karke ink aur dyes nikale jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Pulp is treated with chemicals (like NaOH or Na₂CO₃) to remove inks and dyes.

blocks.prompt:
34 How is glass recycled? Why is it chemically simpler?
(Glass kaise recycle hota hai? Yeh kemiyai taur par aasan kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Toota glass (cullet) saaf, chura aur pighla kar naya glass banaya jata hai. Yeh aasan hai kyun ke glass non-crystalline solid hai.

book_ref.quote: Chemically simpler as glass is a non-crystalline solid.

blocks.prompt:
35 How are metals such as steel and aluminium recycled?
(Steel aur aluminium jaisi metals kaise recycle hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Thermal aur chemical refining (metallurgy) se: scrap ko pighla kar refine kiya jata hai taake impurities nikal jayen. Is mein kafi energy lagti hai magar primary production se bohat kam.

book_ref.quote: Melting and refining processes to remove impurities.

blocks.prompt:
36 What is X-ray crystallography? In which fields is it important?
(X-ray crystallography kya hai? Yeh kin shobon mein ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: X-ray crystallography aik mazboot analytical tool hai jo crystalline solid mein atoms ki teen-dimensional jagahen maloom karta hai. Yeh material science, biochemistry aur pharmaceutical chemistry mein ahem hai kyun ke is se structures nazar aati hain.

book_ref.quote: X-ray crystallography is a very strong analytical tool

blocks.prompt:
37 Why are X-rays used to find the positions of atoms in a molecule?
(Molecule mein atoms ki jagah maloom karne ke liye X-rays kyun istemal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti hai, is liye yeh electromagnetic radiation molecule ya ionic compound mein electrons aur atoms ki jagah maloom karne mein kaam aati hai.

book_ref.quote: X-rays have very small wavelength.

blocks.prompt:
38 What is a diffraction pattern? What does it show?
(Diffraction pattern kya hai? Yeh kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab X-rays crystal par girti hain to khaas angles par diffract hoti hain; yeh rays screen par jo patterns banati hain woh diffraction patterns hain. Pattern atoms aur electrons ki jagah aur atoms ke darmiyan faasla batata hai.

book_ref.quote: A diffraction pattern spots the location of atoms and electrons in a molecule.

blocks.prompt:
39 What are fossil fuels? Give the main uses of natural gas.
(Fossil fuels kya hain? Natural gas ke bare istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Petroleum (crude oil), coal aur natural gas mil kar fossil fuels kehlate hain. Natural gas (zyada tar methane) khana pakane, garmi, bijli aur khaad banane mein; methane se ammonia aur methanol bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Petroleum (crude oil), coal, and natural gas are collectively called fossil fuels.

blocks.prompt:
40 Why is coal still important as a petrochemical raw material?
(Coal ab bhi petrochemical raw material ke taur par kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agarche coal pehle jitna mufeed nahi, phir bhi khaas taur par jahan zakhair zyada hain wahan petrochemical raw material hai. Is se benzene, toluene aur xylene milte hain jo dyes, resins aur explosives mein lagte hain.

book_ref.quote: Coal is not as useful as it was before

blocks.prompt:
41 Write the main uses of petroleum and coal according to Table 31.4.
(Table 31.4 ke mutabiq petroleum aur coal ke bare istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Petroleum: transport fuels (petrol, diesel) aur lubricants. Coal: bijli banana, cement aur steel industries.

book_ref.quote: Transportation fuels (petrol, diesel), lubricants

blocks.text: 31.5 Fractional Distillation and Refining of Petroleum

blocks.prompt:
42 State the principle of fractional distillation of crude oil.
(Crude oil ki fractional distillation ka usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Crude oil hydrocarbons ka pecheeda mixture hai. Fractional distillation ise hydrocarbons ke boiling points ke farq ki bunyaad par physical tareeqe se alag karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Crude oil is a complicated mixture of hydrocarbons and it needs separation

blocks.prompt:
43 Why do lighter hydrocarbons collect near the top of the fractionating column?
(Halke hydrocarbons fractionating column ke ooper kyun jama hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Column mein ooper jate hue temperature kam hota hai. Halke hydrocarbons ka boiling point kam hai, is liye woh der tak vapour rehte hain aur ooper ja kar condense hote hain; bhari, zyada boiling point wale neeche condense hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Since the vapor travels upwards, various hydrocarbon constituents condense at various points

blocks.prompt:
44 Name four fractions of crude oil with one use each.
(Crude oil ke chaar fractions aik aik istemal ke saath batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Gases (LPG) – khana pakana aur garmi; gasoline (petrol) – cars aur bikes ka fuel; kerosene – jet fuel, lamps; diesel – trucks, buses, generators. (Lubricating oils – engine oil, grease; bitumen – sarak, chhat.)

book_ref.quote: Fractions of crude oil (from Figure 31.6)

blocks.prompt:
45 What are petrochemicals and their derivatives?
(Petrochemicals aur un ke derivatives kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Petrochemicals woh chemicals hain jo zyada tar crude oil aur natural gas se refining aur transformation ke zariye milte hain. In se bane synthetic chemicals petrochemicals ke derivatives hain jo polymerization, oxidation ya substitution se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Synthetic chemicals or substances manufactured from petrochemicals represent derivatives of petrochemicals

blocks.prompt:
46 Name the products obtained from ethene and propene and give their uses.
(Ethene aur propene se banne wali products aur un ke istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethene → poly(ethene) plastic: bags, bottles, packaging. Propene → poly(propene): containers, gaariyon ke parts.

book_ref.quote: Table 31.5 Derivatives of petrochemicals and their uses

blocks.prompt:
47 Define cracking. Why is it necessary?
(Cracking ki definition likhein. Yeh kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cracking bare hydrocarbon molecules (aam taur par naphtha ya heavy oils) ko garmi se tor kar chhote, mufeed molecules jaise alkenes banana hai. Yeh zaroori hai kyun ke ethene aur propene plastics aur artificial rubber ke bare raw materials hain.

book_ref.quote: A chemical process involving the thermal dissociation of large hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
48 Differentiate between thermal cracking and catalytic cracking.
(Thermal cracking aur catalytic cracking mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cracking ke dono tareeqon ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Catalytic Cracking on the other hand is more efficient

rows: Koi catalyst nahi
Catalyst: zeolites (aluminosilicates) ya silica-alumina
Bohat zyada temperature (450 °C - 750 °C) aur zyada pressure
Kam temperature (taqreeban 500 °C) aur pressure
Zyada energy chahiye
Energy bachti hai; catalyst activation energy kam karta hai
Alkenes zyada bante hain, jaise C₁₀H₂₂ → C₈H₁₈ + C₂H₄
Zyada efficient, products par behtar control; naphtha → C₂H₄ + C₃H₆

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between cracking and reforming.
(Cracking aur reforming mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cracking aur reforming ka farq:

book_ref.quote: In contrast to cracking (where the molecules are broken down)

rows: Bare hydrocarbon molecules toot'te hain
Hydrocarbons ki molecular structure nayi tarteeb leti hai
Chhote molecules jaise alkenes (ethene, propene) bante hain
Branched ya cyclic (aromatic) structures banti hain
Maqsad: plastics aur artificial rubber ke raw materials
Maqsad: zyada octane fuels jo engine knocking rokte hain

blocks.prompt:
50 What is isomerisation in reforming? Give an example.
(Reforming mein isomerisation kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Isomerisation seedhi chain hydrocarbons ko zyada octane wale branched-chain isomers mein badalna hai, jaise n-hexane (C₆H₁₄) → iso-hexane (iso-C₆H₁₄).

book_ref.quote: The straight chain hydrocarbons are converted into branched-chain isomers

blocks.prompt:
51 What is cyclization? Write its equation for hexane.
(Cyclization kya hai? Hexane ke liye equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cyclization seedhi chain hydrocarbons ko cyclic compounds mein badalna hai aur hydrogen nikalti hai: C₆H₁₄ → C₆H₁₂ + H₂ (hexane se cyclohexane).

book_ref.quote: Cyclic compounds are prepared by the conversion of straight-chain hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
52 What is BTX? How is benzene obtained from hexane in reforming?
(BTX kya hai? Reforming mein hexane se benzene kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: BTX = benzene, toluene aur xylene; plastics, dyes aur synthetic fibres ke building blocks. Hexane Pt catalyst aur heat par hydrogen kho kar aromatic ring banata hai: C₆H₁₄ → C₆H₆ + 4H₂ (hexane se benzene; aam naam dehydrocyclisation ya aromatisation).

book_ref.quote: It is used to generate important chemical base materials

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab is step ko 'dehydrocoupling' aur equation ko 'cyclohexane to benzene' likhti hai. Book correction: equation hexane ki hai; cyclohexane se C₆H₁₂ → C₆H₆ + 3H₂ hota.

blocks.prompt:
53 Differentiate between energy density and specific energy.
(Energy density aur specific energy mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Fuel ko parakhne ke do pemanon ka farq:

book_ref.quote: there are two key aspects used to evaluate a fuel

rows: Fuel ke fi unit volume mein energy
Fuel ke fi unit mass mein energy
Unit: MJ/L
Unit: MJ/kg
Stationary applications aur storage mein ahem (power plants, generators)
Jahan wazan ahem ho wahan (aviation, spacecraft)
Misaal: diesel ~35.8 MJ/L, gasoline ~34.2 MJ/L se zyada
Misaal: hydrogen 120 MJ/kg

blocks.prompt:
54 Calculate the energy stored in 30 L of diesel and in 30 L of gasoline. Which stores more, and by how much?
(30 L diesel aur 30 L gasoline mein store energy maloom karein. Kaun zyada rakhta hai aur kitni?)
blocks.explanation: Diesel: 30 × 35.8 = 1074 MJ. Gasoline: 30 × 34.2 = 1026 MJ. Diesel 1074 − 1026 = 48 MJ zyada rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: diesel is more energy dense (~35.8 MJ/L) in comparison to gasoline (~34.2 MJ/L)

blocks.prompt:
55 Why is hydrogen potentially interesting for aerospace applications?
(Hydrogen aerospace applications ke liye kyun dilchasp hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen ki specific energy bohat zyada (120 MJ/kg) hai, yani zyada mass barhaye baghair bohat energy deti hai; jahan wazan ahem ho wahan yeh zaroori hai. Lekin is ki energy density kam hai.

book_ref.quote: that makes it potentially interesting in aerospace applications

blocks.prompt:
56 Why is CNG suitable for local commuting but not for long travelling?
(CNG local safar ke liye munasib magar lambe safar ke liye kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: CNG sasti hai magar is ki energy density petrol se kam hai, is liye kaafi fuel ke liye zyada storage volume chahiye. Is liye yeh local safar ke liye theek hai, lambe safar ke liye nahi.

book_ref.quote: it is not perfect as a long traveling means

blocks.prompt:
57 Differentiate between nuclear fission and nuclear fusion.
(Nuclear fission aur nuclear fusion mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono nuclear energy dete hain, chemical reactions se kahin zyada; farq neeche hai.

book_ref.quote: Nuclear energy is the energy that is released by nuclei of an atom

blocks.prompt:
59 Name two nuclear accidents mentioned in the chapter and state their effect.
(Chapter mein bataye gaye do nuclear hadsaat ke naam aur un ka asar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Chernobyl haadsa (1986) aur Fukushima haadsa (2011). In se mahol aur insaani sehat ko sakht nuqsan hua; Fukushima mein 150,000 se zyada log nikale gaye.

book_ref.quote: Nuclear power plants extensively use nuclear fission to produce electricity.

blocks.prompt:
60 How does a solar panel produce electricity?
(Solar panel bijli kaise banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Solar panels, aam taur par silicon semiconducting materials ke, photovoltaic effect se roshni ko bijli banate hain: roshni material ke electrons ko activate karti hai aur DC bijli banti hai.

book_ref.quote: Solar PV (photovoltaic) system is a clean energy system

blocks.prompt:
61 State the roles of the inverter and the batteries in a solar PV system.
(Solar PV system mein inverter aur batteries ka kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Inverter: panels ki DC bijli ko gharon, schools, offices aur industries ke liye AC mein badalta hai. Batteries: raat ya baadal wale din ke liye bijli store karti hain aur voltage stable aur surge current mein madad deti hain.

book_ref.quote: This DC electricity is then converted to alternating current (AC) by an inverter

blocks.prompt:
62 Give two advantages of solar energy over traditional energy sources.
(Riwayati energy sources ke muqable mein solar energy ke do faide batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Yeh mahol dost aur renewable hai, is liye climate change aur pollution se larne mein madad deti hai. (ii) Solar panels lambe arse mein saste hain kyun ke lagne ke baad kam dekh-bhaal chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Solar energy has many key advantages over the traditional sources of energy.

blocks.prompt:
63 Why do we need to switch to renewable energy sources?
(Hamein renewable energy sources ki taraf kyun jana chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Energy ki kami, mehnga fuel aur climate ke masail batate hain ke solar, hydro aur wind jaise renewable sources ki taraf jana zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Energy shortages, high fuel prices, and climate problems show that we need to switch
